records.jp: ねえ、愛央。<CR>今、時間ある？
records.en_original: Ao? Are you free?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao? Are you free?
records.en: Hey, Ao.<CR>Do you have time right now?

records.jp: 美弦さんのためなら、いくらでも！
records.en_original: For you, I've got all the time in the world!
records.en_auxiliary: For you, I've got all the time in the world!
records.en: For you, Mio-san, as much as you need!

records.jp: ふふ、大げさね。<CR>新しいお菓子を作ったから、ちょっと味見してほしいの
records.en_original: Hehe, you're exaggerating. I've made a new snack, so I wanted for you to taste test it for me.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you're exaggerating. I've made a new snack, so I wanted for you to taste test it for me.
records.en: Hehe, you're exaggerating.<CR>I made a new sweet, and I'd like you to taste it.

records.jp: やった！　美弦さんが作ったものなら、絶対美味しい！
records.en_original: Aw, yes! Everything you make is incredible!
records.en_auxiliary: Aw, yes! Everything you make is incredible!
records.en: Yes! Anything Mio-san makes is sure to be delicious!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん。お姉ちゃんも
records.en_original: Hi, Ao. Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: Hi, Ao. Mio.
records.en: Ao-chan. Onee-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉。どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hiori. Is there something you need?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori. Is there something you need?
records.en: Hiori. Is there something you need?

records.jp: ちょっと愛央ちゃんに話があって
records.en_original: I had something I needed to talk about with Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I had something I needed to talk about with Ao.
records.en: I had something I needed to talk about with Ao-chan.

records.jp: ……内緒の話？　仲がいいのね
records.en_original: Something that I can't know? Well, aren't you two close.
records.en_auxiliary: Something that I can't know? Well, aren't you two close.
records.en: ...A secret conversation? You two are close.

records.jp: まあ、ちょっとね
records.en_original: Pretty much.
records.en_auxiliary: Pretty much.
records.en: Pretty much.

records.jp: ふうん……
records.en_original: Hmph...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph...
records.en: Hmph...

records.jp: あれ、もしかしてお姉ちゃん、嫉妬してる？
records.en_original: Oh, don't tell me you're jealous, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, don't tell me you're jealous, Mio!
records.en: Oh, are you jealous, Onee-chan?

records.jp: な……そんなこと……
records.en_original: I... I'm not...
records.en_auxiliary: I... I'm not...
records.en: I... I'm not...

records.jp: あはは、お姉ちゃんでもそんな顔するんだなあ。<CR>私の方が、妬けちゃうよ
records.en_original: Ahaha, I never thought I'd see you of all people looking like that. You're gonna make me jealous too.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I never thought I'd see you of all people looking like that. You're gonna make me jealous too.
records.en: Ahaha, even you make that kind of face, Onee-chan.<CR>Now I'm the one getting jealous.

records.jp: もう隠す必要もないから言っちゃうとね。<CR>今愛央ちゃんにしてたの、お姉ちゃんの話なんだ
records.en_original: I don't think there's much of a point in hiding it anymore. Truth is, I was going to talk with Ao about you.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think there's much of a point in hiding it anymore. Truth is, I was going to talk with Ao about you.
records.en: There's no need to hide it anymore, so I'll tell you.<CR>What I was talking to Ao-chan about was you, Onee-chan.

records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、お姉ちゃんに元気になってもらいたくて<CR>ずっと私に相談してたんだよ
records.en_original: Ao has been asking me about you. About how she can cheer you up.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao has been asking me about you. About how she can cheer you up.
records.en: Ao-chan has been consulting me all this time<CR>because she wanted you to feel better, Onee-chan.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんがずっと抱えている想いを晴らすには、<CR>お姉ちゃん自身がお姉ちゃんを許す必要がある
records.en_original: But in order for you to stop feeling guilty, you have to forgive yourself first.
records.en_auxiliary: But in order for you to stop feeling guilty, you have to forgive yourself first.
records.en: To clear away the feelings you've carried all this time,<CR>you need to forgive yourself, Onee-chan.

records.jp: きっとそれにはお姉ちゃんの思い出が必要だから……<CR>だから、同じ思い出を持つ私の記憶を知りたいって
records.en_original: For that, you'll need your memories. So she's been asking me since we share the same memories.
records.en_auxiliary: For that, you'll need your memories. So she's been asking me since we share the same memories.
records.en: She thought your memories would surely be necessary for that...<CR>so she wanted to know my memories, since we share the same ones.

records.jp: そう……だったの
records.en_original: Is...that so.
records.en_auxiliary: Is...that so.
records.en: Is...that so.

records.jp: でも、私の想いは陽桜莉から借りたもの。<CR>そんな私じゃ……
records.en_original: Everything I have is borrowed from you, Hiori. I can't...
records.en_auxiliary: Everything I have is borrowed from you, Hiori. I can't...
records.en: But my feelings are borrowed from Hiori.<CR>Someone like me...

records.jp: ……美弦さん、私思うんだ。<CR>それで何がいけないんだって
records.en_original: You know what I think, Mio? I think that there's nothing wrong with that.
records.en_auxiliary: You know what I think, Mio? I think that there's nothing wrong with that.
records.en: ...Mio-san, this is what I think.<CR>What is wrong with that?

records.jp: 想いってさ……自分だけで生み出すものじゃ<CR>ないと思うんだ
records.en_original: Memories and emotions aren't created by a single person.
records.en_auxiliary: Memories and emotions aren't created by a single person.
records.en: I don't think feelings are something<CR>we create all by ourselves.

records.jp: 人から貰ったもの……託されたもの……<CR>分かち合ったもの……
records.en_original: We create them together with the people that we care about.
records.en_auxiliary: We create them together with the people that we care about.
records.en: Things we receive from others... things entrusted to us...<CR>things we share...

records.jp: そういうもの全部含めて、自分の想いなんだと思う
records.en_original: That's why those feelings and memories you have? They're yours too.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why those feelings and memories you have? They're yours too.
records.en: I think all of those things together become our own feelings.

records.jp: だからね、お姉ちゃん
records.en_original: So, Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: So, Mio...
records.en: So, Onee-chan...

records.jp: 今持っているお姉ちゃんの想いは、<CR>もう借りものなんかじゃなくて、お姉ちゃんのものだよ！
records.en_original: What you have isn't just something you borrowed from me. It's your own!
records.en_auxiliary: What you have isn't just something you borrowed from me. It's your own!
records.en: The feelings you have now<CR>aren't borrowed anymore. They're yours, Onee-chan!

records.jp: ……とまあ、言葉だけで納得できてたら、<CR>もうとっくに解決してるよね
records.en_original: I'm sure words by themselves don't mean much.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure words by themselves don't mean much.
records.en: ...Though if words alone were enough to convince you,<CR>this would have been resolved long ago.

records.jp: うん。だから、行こう。<CR>私たちのココロトープに
records.en_original: Yeah. Which means, we should take a trip to our Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Which means, we should take a trip to our Heartscape.
records.en: Yeah. That's why we should go<CR>to our Heartscape.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんが見つけた思い出を、一緒に見てほしいんだ
records.en_original: I want you to see Hiori's memory of when she found you.
records.en_auxiliary: I want you to see Hiori's memory of when she found you.
records.en: I want you to see the memory Hiori-san found together with us.

records.jp: そして、思い出してほしい。<CR>本当のお姉ちゃんを
records.en_original: And I want you to remember who you really are.
records.en_auxiliary: And I want you to remember who you really are.
records.en: And I want you to remember<CR>the real Onee-chan.

records.jp: 本当の、私……
records.en_original: Who I really am...?
records.en_auxiliary: Who I really am...?
records.en: Who I really am...?
